edit.context: Trip/project sheet heading when editing; {name} is the trip's name.

new.context: Trip/project sheet heading when creating one. A trip or project has its own budget, paid from savings, outside the monthly limits.

namePlaceholder.context: Trip/project sheet: placeholder of the name field.

budgetLabel.context: Trip/project sheet: label of the total budget field.

budget.context: Trip/project: its total budget (field label and stat).

badDates.context: Trip/project sheet: error, the end date is before the start date.

goal.context: Trip/project sheet: which savings goal pays for it.

goalHelp.message: Its spending stays out of the monthly budget either way; this shows it against what was saved.
goalHelp.context: Trip/project sheet: hint under the goal choice.

unarchive.context: Trip/project sheet: button that shows a finished trip on the Add screen again.

archive.message: Finish: take it off the Add screen
archive.context: Trip/project sheet: button that marks the trip as finished.

spentFromGoals.context: Budget tab: heading of the list of trips and goals that were spent from (outside the monthly budget).

overBy.context: Trip card: stat label, how much the trip went over its budget.

left.context: Trip card: stat label, what's left of its budget.

noBudget.context: Trip card: stat value when there's no budget.

untitled.context: Trip card > Where it went: expenses without a note are grouped under this.

whereItWent.context: Trip card: heading of the biggest things the trip's money went on.

startsIn.context: Trip card: the trip hasn't started yet.

startsInPaid.one: Starts in {count} day. {amount} already paid ahead.
startsInPaid.other: Starts in {count} days. {amount} already paid ahead.
startsInPaid.context: Trip card: the trip hasn't started, and {amount} was already spent on it (tickets etc.).

running.context: Trip card: the trip is running.

runningPerDay.one: {count} day to go, today included: about {amount} a day keeps it within budget.
runningPerDay.other: {count} days to go, today included: about {amount} a day keeps it within budget.
runningPerDay.context: Trip card: the trip is running, with what can be spent per day.

finishedUnder.context: Trip card: the trip is over.

finishedOver.context: Trip card: the trip is over.

finished.context: Trip card: the trip is over (no budget).

undated.message: Paid from savings, outside the monthly budget. Add trip dates in Edit to see a daily amount while it runs.
undated.context: Trip card: the trip has no dates.

title.context: Trip/project page heading while loading or when missing.

gone.message: Nothing here: it may have been removed.
gone.context: Trip/project page: it no longer exists.

everyExpense.context: Trip/project page: heading of the list of its expenses.

empty.message: Nothing yet. Tie it to a savings goal in Edit, then add expenses from the Goals tile on the Add tab.

datesBoth.context: Trip/project page: its dates, e.g. '5 May 2027 to 19 May 2027'.

kind.context: Trip/project page: subtitle when it has no dates.
